steps.code:
# Parse each line and find the matching song, then add to playlist
playlist_id = 654
for line in lines:
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_str = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')] if artists_str else []
    # Search for the song by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'], page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match: title matches and all artists are present
    found = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            # Check if all required artists are in song_artists
            if all(any(artist.lower() in sa for sa in song_artists) for artist in artists):
                found = song
                break
    if found:
        add_res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=found['song_id'], access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
        print(f"Added: {found['title']} (id {found['song_id']}) -> {add_res}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {line}")
